project.name: spark-sql-query-pipeline
project.description: Apache Spark v4.2.0 SQL engine core (stage 1): Catalyst trees, rules, logical plans and the query execution pipeline.

nodes.name: LogicalPlan.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract LogicalPlan base class of Catalyst, its LeafNode/UnaryNode/BinaryNode shapes, LogicalQueryStage, and LogicalPlanIntegrity checks used to validate optimized plans. Provides attribute resolution, metadata column handling, and constraint/stat plumbing for every logical operator.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala abstract class mixing in traits (AnalysisHelper, LogicalPlanStats, QueryPlanConstraints), with helper traits and objects defined in the same file.

nodes.name: LogicalPlan
nodes.summary: Abstract base of all logical operators; extends QueryPlan and mixes in analysis helpers, stats and constraints, and offers name resolution (resolve, resolveChildren, resolveQuoted), metadata output and maxRows hooks.

nodes.name: LeafNode
nodes.summary: Logical operator with no children; reports no produced attributes and default stats via computeStats.

nodes.name: LogicalQueryStage
nodes.summary: Logical-plan leaf that wraps a physical stage (adaptive query execution) so re-optimization can see a materialized subtree.

nodes.name: UnaryNode
nodes.summary: Logical operator with exactly one child; derives constraints by propagating child constraints through its output expressions.

nodes.name: BinaryNode
nodes.summary: Marker trait for logical operators with two children (left and right).

nodes.name: OrderPreservingUnaryNode
nodes.summary: Unary logical node that preserves child ordering, exposing outputExpressions and orderingExpressions.

nodes.name: LogicalPlanIntegrity
nodes.summary: Utility object validating plan integrity: unique expression IDs, no dangling references, aggregate expression validity, and output schema consistency of optimized plans.

nodes.name: ExposesMetadataColumns
nodes.summary: Trait for logical nodes that expose hidden metadata columns, resolving conflicts between metadata and regular output names.

nodes.name: QueryExecution.scala
nodes.summary: Central driver of the SQL query execution pipeline: lazily moves a logical plan through analyzed, command-executed, normalized, cached, optimized, physical (sparkPlan) and executedPlan phases. Also handles explain output, transactions, observed metrics, shuffle cleanup mode and debug codegen.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of lazy val phases and by-name blocks (executePhase, withAbortTransactionOnFailure) so each pipeline stage is computed once on demand and timed by QueryPlanningTracker.

nodes.name: QueryExecution
nodes.summary: Holds the lazily evaluated stages of query processing: analyzed, commandExecuted, withCachedData, optimizedPlan, sparkPlan, executedPlan and toRdd, applying preparation rules before execution and rendering explain strings.

nodes.name: CommandExecutionMode
nodes.summary: Enumeration controlling whether commands are eagerly executed (ALL), skipped, or only analyzed during query execution.

nodes.name: ShuffleCleanupMode
nodes.summary: Sealed trait with DoNotCleanup, SkipMigration and RemoveShuffleFiles variants describing shuffle file cleanup after a query ends.

nodes.name: SparkOptimizer.scala
nodes.summary: Spark's concrete Optimizer, extending the Catalyst Optimizer with SQL-engine-specific rule batches such as partition pruning, dynamic pruning, Python UDF extraction, and user-defined extra optimizations.

nodes.name: SparkOptimizer
nodes.summary: Extends Optimizer to add execution-layer rule batches (early scan pushdown, pre/post-hoc batches, experimental extra optimizations) and registers non-excludable rules.

nodes.name: SparkPlan.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the physical-plan base class SparkPlan along with LeafExecNode, UnaryExecNode and BinaryExecNode traits. Implements the execute/executeColumnar/executeBroadcast contracts, subquery preparation, metrics, and driver-side collect/take helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Template-method design: final execute() wraps abstract doExecute() with prepare, subquery waiting and RDD scope handling.

nodes.name: SparkPlan
nodes.summary: Abstract physical operator extending QueryPlan: exposes partitioning and distribution requirements, row and columnar execution paths, prepare/doExecute lifecycle, SQL metrics, logical link tracking, and executeCollect/executeTake.

nodes.name: LeafExecNode
nodes.summary: Trait for physical operators without children, with produced attributes and verbose string including output.

nodes.name: UnaryExecNode
nodes.summary: Trait for single-child physical operators with an unapply extractor and verbose explain output.

nodes.name: BinaryExecNode
nodes.summary: Trait for two-child physical operators with verbose explain output including both children.

nodes.name: SparkPlanner.scala
nodes.summary: Concrete query planner that turns an optimized LogicalPlan into SparkPlan candidates by applying an ordered list of strategies, including user-provided and extension strategies, and prunes candidates.

nodes.name: SparkPlanner
nodes.summary: Planner extending SparkStrategies that defines the strategy order, collects planLater placeholders, prunes candidate plans, and offers a pruneFilterProject helper.

nodes.name: QueryPlanner.scala
nodes.summary: Defines GenericStrategy and the QueryPlanner base class that turns a logical plan into candidate physical plans by applying an ordered list of strategies, with placeholder planning via planLater and plan pruning.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Scala type parameters (PhysicalPlan <: TreeNode[PhysicalPlan]) so the planner is generic over the physical plan type; plans are produced lazily through Iterators.

nodes.name: RuleExecutor.scala
nodes.summary: Implements RuleExecutor, the batch-based engine that applies Catalyst rules to a tree either once or to a fixed point, with metrics tracking, plan change logging and plan integrity validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a companion object with shared QueryExecutionMetering and sealed Strategy case classes (Once, FixedPoint) to model batch execution policy.

nodes.name: TreeNode.scala
nodes.summary: Core Catalyst tree abstraction: TreeNode with transform and traversal APIs, tree pattern bitsets, tags, copy and child replacement, string and JSON rendering, plus the Leaf/Unary/Binary/Ternary/Quaternary child-arity mixins.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of F-bounded polymorphism (BaseType <: TreeNode[BaseType]), self-types, Scala reflection for makeCopy and JSON, and trait mixins for fixed child arity.

nodes.name: GenericStrategy
nodes.summary: Abstract planning strategy that maps a logical plan to zero or more candidate physical plans and provides the planLater placeholder hook.

nodes.name: QueryPlanner
nodes.summary: Abstract planner that applies its strategies to a logical plan, expands planLater placeholders recursively, and prunes the resulting candidates.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Generates an iterator of physical plans by running all strategies, substituting placeholders with recursively planned children, and pruning bad candidates.

nodes.name: RuleExecutor
nodes.summary: Abstract base for rule-driven tree transformers that runs ordered batches of rules once or to a fixed point and tracks metrics and effectiveness; the companion object holds shared metering.

nodes.name: PlanChangeLogger
nodes.summary: Helper that logs per-rule plan changes, batch-level effectiveness and rule timing metrics at a configurable log level.

nodes.name: Strategy
nodes.summary: Sealed base describing how many iterations a rule batch may run (Once or FixedPoint with max iterations).

nodes.name: logRule
nodes.summary: Logs the before/after plan diff when a rule changes the plan, honoring configured rule-name filters.

nodes.name: logBatch
nodes.summary: Logs whether a rule batch changed the plan and shows the plan diff for the batch.

nodes.name: logMetrics
nodes.summary: Logs time spent, run counts and effective counts per rule from the supplied metrics.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Core loop applying each batch's rules sequentially, repeating to fixed point or max iterations, tracking rule effectiveness, timing and plan integrity validation.

nodes.name: TreeNode
nodes.summary: Base class of all Catalyst trees providing children access, traversals (foreach/map/collect), pruned transform down/up, copying with new children, tags, pattern bits and tree string/JSON rendering.

nodes.name: TreeNodeTag
nodes.summary: Typed key used to attach arbitrary metadata tags to a TreeNode.

nodes.name: AlwaysProcess
nodes.summary: Singleton condition function that always returns true, used as the default condition for pruned transforms.

nodes.name: LeafLike
nodes.summary: Trait for tree nodes with no children, fixing children to Nil.

nodes.name: UnaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with exactly one child, supplying children, mapChildren and withNewChildrenInternal.

nodes.name: BinaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with left and right children, supplying children and mapChildren implementations.

nodes.name: TernaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with three children (first, second, third) and matching child mapping.

nodes.name: QuaternaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with four children and matching child mapping.

nodes.name: MultiTransform
nodes.summary: Helper object providing a cartesian product of alternative transformation results for multiTransformDown.

nodes.name: getDefaultTreePatternBits
nodes.summary: Computes the default tree pattern bitset by OR-ing node patterns with those of its children.

nodes.name: mergeTagsFrom
nodes.summary: Copies tags from another node without overwriting tags already present.

nodes.name: childrenFastEquals
nodes.summary: Checks element-wise reference equality between two child sequences to detect unchanged children.

nodes.name: withNewChildren
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the node with replaced children, preserving tags and origin, and short-circuiting when children are unchanged.

nodes.name: legacyWithNewChildren
nodes.summary: Reflection-based fallback that rebuilds a node with new children by mapping constructor arguments.

nodes.name: transformDownWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies a rule top-down (pre-order) to the tree, skipping subtrees pruned by pattern bits or the rule-ineffectiveness cache.

nodes.name: transformUpWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies a rule bottom-up (post-order), skipping pruned subtrees and marking ineffective rules.

nodes.name: transformUpWithBeforeAndAfterRuleOnChildren
nodes.summary: Bottom-up transform that runs a rule before and after child transformation for rules needing both views.

nodes.name: multiTransformDownWithPruning
nodes.summary: Top-down transform where a rule can return multiple alternatives per node, producing a lazy stream of all alternative trees.

nodes.name: makeCopy
nodes.summary: Reflectively constructs a copy of the node with new constructor arguments, handling otherCopyArgs and error reporting.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Overrides clone to deep-copy the node tree and children while retaining tags.

nodes.name: formatArg
nodes.summary: Formats a single node argument for display, truncating by configured string length.

nodes.name: argString
nodes.summary: Builds the comma-separated argument string for a node's simple or verbose description.

nodes.name: treeString
nodes.summary: Renders the tree as an indented multi-line string with options for verbosity, ids and output columns.

nodes.name: numberedTreeString
nodes.summary: Renders the tree string prefixed with per-node numbers for referencing nodes by index.

nodes.name: getNodeNumbered
nodes.summary: Looks up a node in the tree by its pre-order number.

nodes.name: generateTreeString
nodes.summary: Recursively writes this node and its children (including inner children) with ASCII tree prefixes and truncation limits.

nodes.name: jsonFields
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON field list for a node from its constructor parameters via reflection.

nodes.name: parseToJson
nodes.summary: Converts an arbitrary constructor argument (nodes, options, collections, case classes) into a JSON value.

nodes.name: shouldConvertToJson
nodes.summary: Decides whether a given value type can be converted to JSON.

nodes.name: QueryPlan.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract QueryPlan base class shared by logical and physical plans, adding expression transforms, attribute rewriting, subquery-aware traversal and canonicalization on top of TreeNode. Also provides the QueryPlan companion with expression normalization helpers and a pattern bit mask object.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an F-bounded generic (PlanType <: QueryPlan[PlanType]) with a self-type annotation so transforms return the concrete plan type; caches derived values with BestEffortLazyVal.

nodes.name: QueryPlan
nodes.summary: Abstract base class of all Catalyst logical and physical plan nodes, extending TreeNode. Declares output, references and expressions, expression transform APIs, attribute rewriting, subquery traversal, canonicalization and semantic equality.

nodes.name: QueryPlan companion object
nodes.summary: Companion object with the codegen id tag, a thread-local plan id map for explain output, and helpers to normalize expression ids and predicates for canonicalization plus plan string formatting.

nodes.name: QueryPlanPatternBitMask
nodes.summary: Holds a precomputed BitSet mask covering all tree patterns below OPERATOR_START, used to separate expression patterns from operator patterns.

nodes.name: nodeWithOutputColumnsString
nodes.summary: Renders the node name with its output columns and nullability, truncating after maxColumns.

nodes.name: inputSet
nodes.summary: Computes the AttributeSet produced by all children, tolerating unresolved children.

nodes.name: missingInput
nodes.summary: Returns referenced attributes that are neither provided by children nor produced by this node, used to detect unresolved plans.

nodes.name: transformExpressionsWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies a rule to every expression of this plan node with tree-pattern pruning, delegating to the down variant.

nodes.name: transformExpressionsDownWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies the rule to expressions top-down with pruning conditions and rule id for ineffective-rule tracking.

nodes.name: transformExpressionsUpWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies the rule to expressions bottom-up with pruning conditions and rule id.

nodes.name: mapExpressions
nodes.summary: Core helper that applies a function to every Expression among the node constructor arguments (recursing through Seq, Map, Option, tuples) and rebuilds the node via makeCopy if anything changed.

nodes.name: transformAllExpressionsWithPruning
nodes.summary: Transforms all expressions in the whole plan tree with pruning, combining transformWithPruning and transformExpressionsDownWithPruning.

nodes.name: transformUpWithNewOutput
nodes.summary: Bottom-up plan rewrite where the rule also returns old-to-new attribute mappings, which are propagated to ancestors so references to changed output attributes are rewritten.

nodes.name: rewriteAttrs
nodes.summary: Rewrites attribute references in this plan using the given mapping, including subquery expressions.

nodes.name: updateAttr
nodes.summary: Maps an attribute through an AttributeMap while preserving its name, qualifier and metadata.

nodes.name: updateOuterReferencesInSubquery
nodes.summary: Rewrites outer references inside subquery plans after the outer attributes change.

nodes.name: simpleStringWithNodeId
nodes.summary: Builds the one-line plan description prefixed with the operator id from the thread-local id map.

nodes.name: verboseStringWithOperatorId
nodes.summary: Produces the multi-line verbose explain block for a node with operator id, arguments, output and codegen id.

nodes.name: formattedNodeName
nodes.summary: Returns the node name decorated with operator id and whole-stage codegen id for explain output.

nodes.name: subqueriesAll
nodes.summary: Collects all subquery plans of this plan tree, including nested subqueries.

nodes.name: transformUpWithSubqueries
nodes.summary: Post-order transform that recurses into subquery plans before applying the rule to the node.

nodes.name: transformUpWithSubqueriesAndPruning
nodes.summary: Pruned bottom-up transform that also rewrites plans embedded in PlanExpression subqueries.

nodes.name: transformDownWithSubqueriesAndPruning
nodes.summary: Pruned top-down transform that descends into PlanExpression subquery plans.

nodes.name: foreachWithSubqueriesAndPruning
nodes.summary: Runs a function over every node, including subquery plans, skipping subtrees that fail the pruning condition.

nodes.name: collectFirstWithSubqueries
nodes.summary: Like collectFirst but also searches subquery plans.

nodes.name: doCanonicalize
nodes.summary: Default canonicalization: canonicalizes children and normalizes expression ids to ordinals so semantically equal plans compare equal.

nodes.name: sameResult
nodes.summary: Returns whether two plans are semantically equivalent by comparing canonicalized forms.

nodes.name: validateNodePatterns
nodes.summary: Asserts that the declared nodePatterns of a plan are consistent with the operator pattern mask.

nodes.name: normalizeExpressions
nodes.summary: Companion helper that rewrites AttributeReferences to BoundReference ordinals and canonicalizes subquery plans so expressions can be compared across plans.

nodes.name: normalizePredicates
nodes.summary: Normalizes a predicate sequence by combining with And, normalizing and splitting back into conjuncts.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends a plan tree string with output info to a writer using truncation limits, used by explain.

nodes.name: generateFieldString
nodes.summary: Formats a named field in plan string output depending on whether the value is a collection.

nodes.name: SparkStrategies.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SparkStrategy, PlanLater and the SparkStrategies planner base class with the built-in physical planning strategies (limits, joins, aggregation, windows, streaming, Python evals, basic operators) that turn optimized logical plans into SparkPlans.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala objects nested inside an abstract class with a self-type (self: SparkPlanner =>), each extending Strategy and pattern matching on logical plan nodes via extractors.

nodes.name: SparkStrategy
nodes.summary: Abstract base for Spark physical planning strategies; binds planLater to produce PlanLater placeholders for unplanned child logical plans.

nodes.name: PlanLater
nodes.summary: Leaf physical placeholder wrapping a logical plan that the planner will replace with a real SparkPlan later; it cannot be executed.

nodes.name: SparkStrategies
nodes.summary: Abstract planner extending QueryPlanner[SparkPlan] that holds all built-in strategies as nested objects and links each produced physical plan back to its logical plan.

nodes.name: SpecialLimits
nodes.summary: Strategy planning special limit cases such as CollectLimit, TakeOrderedAndProject and global limits.

nodes.name: JoinSelection
nodes.summary: Strategy selecting the physical join (broadcast hash, shuffle hash, sort merge, broadcast nested loop, cartesian) based on hints, statistics and join type.

nodes.name: EventTimeWatermarkStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy mapping the logical EventTimeWatermark node to its physical watermark operator for streaming queries.

nodes.name: StatefulAggregationStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming aggregations and session window aggregates with state store backed operators.

nodes.name: StreamingDeduplicationStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming deduplication into a state-backed physical operator.

nodes.name: StreamingGlobalLimitStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning global limits on streaming plans, only in append-style output modes.

nodes.name: StreamingJoinStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning stream-stream joins into StreamingSymmetricHashJoinExec.

nodes.name: Aggregation
nodes.summary: Strategy planning aggregates into hash, object hash or sort aggregates, including distinct aggregate handling.

nodes.name: Window
nodes.summary: Strategy planning Window logical nodes into window physical operators, including Python window UDFs.

nodes.name: WindowGroupLimit
nodes.summary: Strategy planning WindowGroupLimit logical nodes into their physical operator.

nodes.name: InMemoryScans
nodes.summary: Strategy planning scans over cached in-memory relations into InMemoryTableScanExec.

nodes.name: StreamingRelationStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming relations and streaming sources into their physical scan operators.

nodes.name: FlatMapGroupsWithStateStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming flatMapGroupsWithState into a stateful physical operator.

nodes.name: StreamingTransformWithStateStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming transformWithState operators, including initial state handling.

nodes.name: TransformWithStateInPySparkStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning transformWithState variants executed in Python.

nodes.name: FlatMapGroupsInPandasWithStateStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning applyInPandasWithState into its physical Python operator.

nodes.name: PythonEvals
nodes.summary: Strategy planning Python UDF evaluation nodes (Arrow, batch, aggregate UDFs) into physical eval operators.

nodes.name: SparkScripts
nodes.summary: Strategy planning script transformation nodes into script transformation physical operators.

nodes.name: Pipelines
nodes.summary: Strategy planning declarative pipeline logical nodes into physical operators.

nodes.name: BasicOperators
nodes.summary: Catch-all strategy mapping the remaining logical operators (project, filter, sort, union, sample, commands, write nodes, etc.) to physical operators.

nodes.name: extractTableNameForError
nodes.summary: Derives a user-friendly table name from a logical plan (DSv2, catalog table or named relation) for error messages.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.scala
nodes.summary: Implements Spark SQL whole-stage code generation: the CodegenSupport produce/consume protocol, the InputAdapter leaf, the WholeStageCodegenExec operator that compiles a pipeline of operators into one Java class, and the CollapseCodegenStages rule that inserts these stages into a physical plan.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala traits provide mixin-style operator capabilities; WholeStageCodegenExec has a companion object with static helpers and a second parameter list (codegenStageId) that is excluded from case-class equality.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport
nodes.summary: Trait for physical operators that can participate in whole-stage codegen. Defines the produce/consume code generation protocol, variable evaluation helpers, and the copy-result and limit/stop-check hooks.

nodes.name: BlockingOperatorWithCodegen
nodes.summary: Mixin for blocking operators that buffer rows before producing output, disabling result copying and stop checks in the generated code.

nodes.name: InputRDDCodegen
nodes.summary: Trait for codegen leaf nodes that read rows from an input RDD iterator and generate the loop that feeds them to the parent operator.

nodes.name: InputAdapter
nodes.summary: Leaf node that hides a non-codegen SparkPlan subtree from a whole-stage codegen stage, delegating execution to its child and consuming its RDD of InternalRow.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec
nodes.summary: Physical operator (with a companion object of codegen-time metrics and field-count helpers) that compiles a subtree of codegen-capable operators into a single generated Java class, compiles it, and executes it with a fallback to the interpreted child on failure.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages
nodes.summary: Physical planning Rule that decides which operators support codegen, wraps non-codegen children in InputAdapter, and inserts WholeStageCodegenExec with sequential stage IDs.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.variablePrefix
nodes.summary: Chooses a short variable-name prefix for the current operator (for example hashAgg, bhj, smj) based on its concrete type, falling back to the lowercased node name.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.produce
nodes.summary: Entry point that generates Java source for an operator by recording the parent and delegating to doProduce within executeQuery.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.prepareRowVar
nodes.summary: Builds the ExprCode for the current input row, materializing a row variable and per-column variable declarations as needed.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.consume
nodes.summary: Generates the code that passes this operator's output variables to its parent, splitting into a separate doConsume method when parameter limits and size conditions require it.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.constructDoConsumeFunction
nodes.summary: Wraps the parent's doConsume body in a generated helper function and returns the call that invokes it, to keep generated methods under the JVM size limit.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.constructConsumeParameters
nodes.summary: Computes the parameter list, argument list, and input variables for a split doConsume function from the required attributes.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.evaluateRequiredVariables
nodes.summary: Emits evaluation code only for the input variables that are actually required by the consumer.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.evaluateNondeterministicVariables
nodes.summary: Emits evaluation code for variables that depend on nondeterministic expressions so they are computed exactly once.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.needCopyResult
nodes.summary: Determines whether the produced rows must be copied before being buffered, by checking whether the parent or this node reuses row objects.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.limitNotReachedCond
nodes.summary: Builds the boolean condition used in generated loops to stop early once all LIMIT-style operators have been satisfied.

nodes.name: InputRDDCodegen.doProduce
nodes.summary: Generates the row-iteration loop over the input RDD iterator, converting each row and calling consume on the parent.

nodes.name: InputAdapter.generateTreeString
nodes.summary: Renders the adapter in the plan tree string with a distinguishing prefix for the codegen subtree.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.isTooManyFields
nodes.summary: Checks whether a data type's nested field count exceeds the configured whole-stage codegen limit, so codegen can be skipped for very wide schemas.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.doCodeGen
nodes.summary: Creates a CodegenContext, produces the child pipeline, assembles the generated BufferedRowIterator subclass, and cleans and formats the source into CodeAndComment.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.doExecute
nodes.summary: Compiles the generated code (falling back to the child plan on compile failure or oversized methods) and runs it over the input RDDs via mapPartitionsWithIndex.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.doConsume
nodes.summary: Final consume step at the top of the stage: writes the output row to the buffered row output and checks for stop conditions.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.generateTreeString
nodes.summary: Renders the codegen stage with its stage ID prefix in the plan tree string.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.tryBroadcastCleanedSource
nodes.summary: Broadcasts the generated source to executors when it exceeds the configured size threshold, otherwise returns it inline.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.supportCodegen
nodes.summary: Decides whether a SparkPlan can run inside a codegen stage, rejecting plans with CodegenFallback expressions or too many input/output fields.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.insertInputAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps operators that do not support codegen (and the children of sort-merge and shuffled-hash joins) in InputAdapter while recursing over the plan.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.insertWholeStageCodegen
nodes.summary: Recursively inserts WholeStageCodegenExec above eligible CodegenSupport operators, skipping object outputs and driver-local scan nodes, and assigns increasing stage IDs.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.apply
nodes.summary: Rule entry point that runs insertWholeStageCodegen when whole-stage codegen is enabled and the factory mode is not NO_CODEGEN, otherwise returns the plan unchanged.

layers.name: Tree and Rule Foundation
layers.description: Generic Catalyst machinery: the TreeNode abstraction and the RuleExecutor that applies rule batches to trees.

layers.name: Logical and Physical Plan Model
layers.description: Shared QueryPlan base, logical operators (LogicalPlan) and physical operators (SparkPlan).

layers.name: Optimization and Planning
layers.description: The optimizer that rewrites logical plans, the planner machinery and the strategies that turn them into physical plans.

layers.name: Query Execution Driver
layers.description: QueryExecution, which drives a query through the pipeline stages.

layers.name: Whole-Stage Code Generation
layers.description: The produce/consume code generation protocol and the rule that fuses operators into generated stages.

tour.title: The pipeline driver: QueryExecution
tour.description: Start here. QueryExecution exposes each stage of query processing as a member: analyzed, commandExecuted, withCachedData, optimizedPlan, sparkPlan, executedPlan and finally toRdd. It wires together the optimizer, the planner and the physical plan classes covered in the next steps.

tour.title: Everything is a tree: TreeNode and QueryPlan
tour.description: Both logical and physical plans are Catalyst trees. TreeNode provides traversal and transform APIs, which is what lets rules rewrite plans by pattern matching. QueryPlan extends TreeNode and is the base shared by logical and physical plans, adding expression transforms, subquery-aware traversal and canonicalization.

tour.title: Applying rules: RuleExecutor
tour.description: RuleExecutor runs ordered batches of rules over a tree, either once or repeatedly until a fixed point. The optimizer is built on it.

tour.title: Logical operators: LogicalPlan
tour.description: LogicalPlan is the base of all logical operators, with LeafNode, UnaryNode and BinaryNode shapes. This is the tree that analysis and optimization work on.

tour.title: The concrete optimizer: SparkOptimizer
tour.description: SparkOptimizer extends the Catalyst Optimizer with rule batches specific to the SQL engine, defined through defaultBatches. The base Optimizer is not part of this stage of the graph.

tour.title: From logical to physical: QueryPlanner, SparkPlanner and SparkStrategies
tour.description: QueryPlanner applies a list of strategies to a logical plan and expands planLater placeholders. SparkStrategies defines SparkStrategy, PlanLater and the built-in physical planning strategies (limits, joins, aggregation, windows, streaming, Python evals, basic operators). SparkPlanner extends SparkStrategies and supplies the concrete strategy order.

tour.title: Physical operators: SparkPlan
tour.description: SparkPlan is the base of physical operators, with LeafExecNode, UnaryExecNode and BinaryExecNode shapes. Its subclasses execute the query.

tour.title: Fusing operators: whole-stage code generation
tour.description: WholeStageCodegenExec compiles a pipeline of physical operators into one Java class using the CodegenSupport produce/consume protocol. The CollapseCodegenStages rule inserts these stages into a physical plan, with InputAdapter as the leaf where fusion stops.
